title: [Positive] Thorough input validation with no panic paths
description:
File: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs

All from_bytes functions perform thorough input validation:
- Length checks before indexing (lines 176-177, 301-302)
- Padding bit validation to detect malformed input (line 198-200)
- Canonical encoding verification for ACKs (lines 311-314, 352-354)
- Bounds validation on all variable-length fields

No panic paths are reachable from malformed external input. All error cases return Result errors. This is correct for protocol boundary code.
